note: Differences from the Fastify baseline that were reviewed and accepted. `pnpm contract:parity` reports a matching difference as explained instead of failing. Anything not listed fails the gate.

accepted.reason: New operation (2026-11-11, AUTHORIZATION Q25): restore a deactivated tenant inside its retention window; permission platform.tenant.restore (Super Admin only); error TENANT_DEACTIVATION_EXPIRED.
The derived (superset) domain error codes of the platform-tenants module now include TENANT_DEACTIVATION_EXPIRED, which only the restore action raises.
Tenant detail responses gained the nullable field tenant.restorableUntil (Q25); allowedActions can now contain "restore".

Edge hardening (2026-11-11): creating and side-effect POSTs accept the optional Idempotency-Key header (409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT) and sign-in/write routes have per-route rate limits (429 RATE_LIMITED).
Same change: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and RATE_LIMITED are now possible on these operations.
Same change: the Idempotency-Key header parameter and the 400/409/429 responses are documented.
New operations (2026-11-11): read access to the tenant audit log (audit_log.view_all) and the platform audit log (platform.audit_log.view); filters actor, action, date range, result.

New operations of the pipelines and triggers module (docs/modules/pipelines-triggers/SPEC.md §8, implementation part C, 2026-11-12): pipelines (list, create, get, edit metadata, enable, disable, soft delete), immutable configuration versions (list, get, publish N+1 with expectedVersion), manual run (Idempotency-Key required), the pipeline's execution requests and trigger decisions (read only), the dry-run of triggers and the wizard options. Permissions pipeline.view / pipeline.manage / pipeline.manage_fork_policy / pipeline.delete / execution.view / execution.run (workspace scope). No route updates or deletes a configuration version.

New operations of the pipelines and triggers module (docs/modules/pipelines-triggers/SPEC.md §8, implementation part C, 2026-11-12): pipelines (list, create, get, edit metadata, enable, disable, soft delete), immutable configuration versions (list, get, publish N+1 with expectedVersion), manual run (Idempotency-Key required), the pipeline's execution requests and trigger decisions (read only), the dry-run of triggers and the wizard options. Permissions pipeline.view / pipeline.manage / pipeline.manage_fork_policy / pipeline.delete / execution.view / execution.run (workspace scope). No route updates or deletes a configuration version. 2026-11-13: the trigger decisions of GET /pipelines/{id}/trigger-decisions gained `sourceType` (scm_event, schedule_slot, manual), `scmDeliveryId`, `scheduleSlot`, `manualKey` and the `sourceType` filter (SPEC §7.8).

New operations of the repositories and GitHub integration module (docs/modules/repositories-github/SPEC.md §8): integrations catalog and installation lifecycle, repositories, and the GitHub webhook route.

New operation (2026-11-12, SPEC §16.2, owner-approved): "Use an existing installation", step 1 of the two-step discovery. Permission workspace_integration.manage in the workspace; tenant setting off gives 403 workspace_linking_disabled; returns the same { authorizeUrl } as authorize but mints a state with the purpose discover and no installation id. Step 2 is the existing POST /integrations/github/links, which answers 200 { mode: "discover", truncated, candidates } for such a state and links nothing (201 for a linking state, unchanged). No operation of the Fastify baseline is involved.

New operations (2026-11-12, SPEC §18 / ADR-012, AUTHORIZATION Q26): workspace-level GitHub linking (start, authorize, test connection, workspace unlink, repository allow-list); permissions workspace_integration.view / workspace_integration.manage (workspace scope). Replaces the 2026-11-11 routing operations GET/PUT /workspaces/{ws}/integrations[/{linkId}] and the tenant-level link operations (start, authorize, link, refresh, scope, unlink under /integrations/github/installations), which no longer exist; none of them was in the Fastify baseline.

New operations of the user-preferences module (docs/modules/user-preferences/SPEC.md §8, 2026-11-13, owner decision): the signed-in user's own interface preferences (accent colour) in the active tenant. Tenant audience, no permission, no id in path/body/query, PUT rate-limited (write profile).

New operations of the tenant-ai-settings module (docs/modules/scan-decisioning/SPEC.md 7.2a and 17.b, ADR-013, owner decisions AP-6 and AP-7, 2026-11-17): the organization's audited data-egress consent for an external AI provider. Tenant audience; GET needs tenant_settings.view, PUT needs tenant_settings.manage (existing keys, Admin bundle), strict body { externalConsent }, PUT rate-limited (write profile); the tenant comes from the session only.

Cursor pagination on the Root Console tenant list (2026-11-13, owner decision, API_STANDARDS "Cursor pagination"): the opt-in query parameters cursor and limit, and the transport error code INVALID_CURSOR (400) for an invalid or foreign HMAC-signed cursor. Offset paging (page, pageSize) is unchanged; meta.pagination gains nextCursor and hasMore.

New operations of the executions module (docs/modules/executions/SPEC.md §8.1, part G, 2026-11-16): list (GET /executions, cursor pagination; amended 2026-11-16: optional `page` (1-based, with `limit`) adds numbered pages and `totalItems`/`totalPages`/`page`/`pageSize` in meta.pagination, counted over the same tenant-scoped, accessible-workspace filters as the rows, `page * limit` at most 10 000, `page` with `cursor` is 400), detail, events (status history) and logs (GET /executions/{executionId}[/events|/logs]), cancel and retry (POST /executions/{executionId}/cancel|retry). Tenant audience; permissions execution.view / execution.cancel / execution.run (workspace scope via the execution's workspace); cancel and retry are rate limited (write profile) and accept Idempotency-Key, retry REQUIRES it; logs use the new read rate-limit profile. No route under /api/v1/platform. No artifact or separate task endpoint (tasks are embedded in the detail).

New operation (2026-11-17, owner decision, AUTHORIZATION decision 30): Organization overview data for the tenant (accessibleWorkspaces, counted only among the caller's visible active workspaces). Tenant audience, tenant-scope permission dashboard.view (Admin built-in bundle only; 403 for everyone else), strict empty query (a tenant or workspace id there is a 400), no path/body identifiers.

New operations of the findings module, Part A1 (docs/modules/findings/SPEC.md 8.1, docs/modules/findings/AS_BUILT_A1.md, 2026-11-23): the read routes GET /findings (filters, saved views, numbered or cursor pages, workspaceId required), GET /findings/summary, GET /findings/{id} (detail with evidence, commit-pinned link, advisory and allowed actions, ETag), GET /findings/{id}/history (newest first), GET /findings/{id}/comments (oldest first) and GET /findings/{id}/similar. Tenant audience; permission finding.view (workspace scope, through the workspace of the query or of the finding); read rate-limit profile. No write route yet (Parts B, C and D). None of them was in the Fastify baseline.

New operation of the findings module, Part D-integration (docs/modules/findings/SPEC.md 8.2, docs/modules/findings/AS_BUILT_D2.md, 2026-11-24): POST /findings/{id}/advisory/request asks the false-positive advisory agent for a fresh suggestion. Tenant audience; permission finding.review (workspace scope, through the workspace of the finding); write rate-limit profile and Idempotency-Key; 202 with the advisory DTO (status pending). Writes one outbox job and one audit entry only and never changes the finding. Not in the Fastify baseline.

New operations of the findings module, Part B (docs/modules/findings/SPEC.md 8.1, 8.2, docs/modules/findings/AS_BUILT_B.md, 2026-11-24): GET /review-queue and GET /approvals (the latter with canDecide and cannotDecideReason computed per caller), POST claim, reviews (record a decision), reviews/{reviewId}/withdraw|approve|reject, reopen-review, comments, exceptions (accepted risk or suppression request; the key depends on the body kind) and exceptions/{exceptionId}/withdraw|approve|reject|revoke, and POST /findings/bulk/claim. Tenant audience; workspace-scope permissions finding.review, finding.comment, approval.view, approval.approve, approval.reject, security_review.view (finding.view for withdraw and revoke, whose service then checks the requester or the key of the exception's kind); write and read rate-limit profiles; every POST accepts Idempotency-Key; stale or disallowed transitions are 409 FINDING_STATE_CONFLICT. None of them was in the Fastify baseline.

New operations of the findings module, Part C (docs/modules/findings/SPEC.md 8.1, 8.2, docs/modules/findings/AS_BUILT_C.md, 2026-11-24): the remediation board (GET /remediation/board and GET /remediation/board/{column}, keyset paged, permission remediation.view in the workspace of the query, the card carries the PR link and ticket key of the latest submitted fix), the assignment and remediation writes (POST /findings/{id}/assignments, /assignments/clear, /remediation/start, /remediation/submit and POST /findings/bulk/assign; permissions finding.assign and finding.remediate in the finding's workspace, the assignee rule of RM-1 enforced in the service) and the tenant SLA targets (GET and PUT /settings/findings-sla; tenant_settings.view and tenant_settings.manage, the PUT is audited). Tenant audience; read and write rate-limit profiles; every POST accepts Idempotency-Key; stale or disallowed transitions are 409 FINDING_STATE_CONFLICT. None of them was in the Fastify baseline.

New operations of the Reporting and Dashboards module (docs/modules/reporting-dashboards/SPEC.md 9, AS_BUILT_B.md, AS_BUILT_C.md, 2026-11-26): thirteen reads (posture, trends, remediation, sla, aging, scan-activity, coverage, sbom, quality, breakdown, top-risk, workload, overview) and five export operations (create, list, get, download, delete of generated reports). Not part of the Fastify baseline; every route is authenticated, tenant scoped and gated by the keys of SPEC 3; with REPORTING_ENABLED=false they answer 404.
